verdict.rationale: Grafana lets you define dashboards, data sources and other configuration as version-controllable files and code, managed from a CLI suited to CI/CD. That gives a portable, file-based form of your configuration. Its OpenTelemetry docs explicitly claim protection from vendor lock-in and data portability, Tempo works with open tracing protocols, and Grafana queries data wherever it is stored rather than requiring it to live inside Grafana. Missing for 10: no documented one-step export of all data (telemetry stored in Grafana Cloud, alerts, SLOs, incidents), no named open export formats, no documented migration path off Grafana Cloud, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of leaving.
